title: Prove Board edit-to-implementation reconciliation
summary: Build repeatable, revision-pinned proof for the flagship journey of internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace: open repository-backed design truth, edit a screen or diagram, undo and redo, save and reopen, create a proposal, hand it off, and reconcile implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Define the exact critical journey: open repository-backed design truth, edit a screen or diagram, undo and redo, save and reopen, create a proposal, hand it off, and reconcile implementation.
Link the journey to the critical claim: Board documents, commands, undo and redo, source references, assets, migrations, proposals, and recovery remain deterministic and non-destructive.
Record starting state, inputs, identities, configuration, locale, clock, and deterministic fixture data.
Verify the normal path from entry to meaningful completion with behavior-focused assertions.
Verify loading, empty, stale, offline, permission-denied, partial, failure, retry, interruption, and safe-abort states where applicable.
Verify persistence across restart and prevent duplicate side effects on replay.
Verify malformed or adversarial input cannot corrupt state or bypass safety rules.
Verify accessibility semantics, focus or keyboard behavior where relevant, scaling, contrast, reduced motion, and input alternatives.
Verify declared locales and dynamic formatting without relying only on screenshots.
Capture before-and-after performance evidence for critical interactions and memory or throughput risks.
Verify privacy, security, consent, credential, and data-minimization boundaries.
Verify monetization posture `internal-now-optional-commercialization-later` only if applicable, without dark patterns.
Capture the closest practical runtime proof and label remaining simulator, fixture, hardware, staging, or external limitations.
Attach a revision-pinned evidence receipt linking requirements, tests, runtime proof, and reviewer.
Add an adversarial review that attempts to falsify the journey’s most important claim.
Define a repeatable regression sentinel or re-verification command.
Do not add unrelated cross-app integration or product fusion to satisfy proof.
Update status and product documentation only after evidence is current.
